storage.value:
Weekly Delivery Sync — Voice Agent Rollout

Team reviewed the voice-agent rollout for the client contact center. CRM webhook integration is done in staging; telephony routing still has latency issues.

Decisions

  • Go-live moves to Nov 4 if latency < 800ms.
  • Client approves Telegram as the second channel.

Action items

  • Dmytro Shevchuk: fix telephony latency and share benchmark (due 2026-10-24)
  • Olena Bondar: write regression test cases for CRM webhooks (due 2026-10-23)
  • Anna Koval: confirm Telegram bot naming and greeting text (due 2026-10-22)
  • Oleksii Yevchenko: schedule go/no-go call with client stakeholders (due 2026-10-28)
